title: Shaadi No. 1
desc: In their misguided pursuit of happiness outside of marriage, three husbands end up in the crosshairs of a man who is like an elder brother to their wives.

title: Saudagar
desc: Rajesh and Veeru's friendship is tested as greed, betrayal and ambition collide, leading to intense drama, power struggles and emotional turmoil that reshapes their destinies.

title: Tholi Prema
desc: Aditya, an outgoing young man, falls in love with Varsha, an introvert. Varsha has feelings for him but is reluctant to profess them and they both part ways only to meet again after a few years.

title: Radha Ka Sangam
desc: Radha and Govinda are deeply in love, but family traditions and circumstances keep them apart. Their faith and devotion are tested by destiny.

title: Race 3
desc: While planning and executing one of their biggest heists, the members of a criminal family come across some shocking revelations. Thus, their relationships and loyalties are critically tested.

title: Udta Punjab
desc: Udta Punjab follows four people: a rock-star, a migrant worker, a doctor, and a police officer as they confront drugs and danger in Punjab.

title: Kites
desc: In the brutal Mexican desert, mortally wounded J fights for life while hunted, seeking Natasha, the destined love whose arrival reshapes their fates forever together.

title: Beyond The Clouds
desc: Amir, a young man, tries to evade police after a drug raid, but things spiral when his sister is arrested while attempting to protect him, forcing him into a desperate struggle to save her.

title: Notebook
desc: A shy young man discovers love through heartfelt letters and memories, but distance, destiny and emotional struggles test whether their bond can truly survive.

title: Babumoshai Bandookbaaz
desc: A ruthless contract killer lives by his own rules, but when betrayal and ambition collide, his violent journey through crime and revenge takes unexpected and dangerous turns.

title: The Last Color
desc: Choti, a young tightrope walker, dreams of continuing her education but struggles to survive. She befriends Noor, a widow who longs to celebrate Holi but is bound by restrictions.

title: Darlings
desc: Hamza and Badru's love marriage turns toxic as he becomes abusive and alcoholic, but after a devastating incident, Badru decides to fight back and seek justice in her own way.

title: Badhaai Do

desc: A man finds out he has to go live with his birth parents in the city after being brought up in a village. Troubles crop up, which only he can resolve.

title: Mashooq
desc: A romantic drama exploring love, emotions and relationship complexities with intense storytelling and emotional depth.

title: No Entry
desc: Newspaper owner Kishan stays loyal to his suspicious wife, while his friend Prem cheats on his own wife and later introduces Kishan to an alluring prostitute, stirring tension among them.

title: Commando 2 - The Black Money Trail
desc: Commando Karan fights to stop black money, exposing corruption as he tracks funds hidden in foreign banks and recovers stolen wealth for citizens everywhere.

title: Dil Juunglee
desc: Emotionally guarded strangers Sumit and Karishma enter a fake relationship to solve personal problems, but their plan slowly turns real as genuine love grows.

title: Jawaani Jaaneman
desc: Jazz, a 40-year-old Casanova in London, lives a carefree life until Tia, a young girl claiming to be his daughter, arrives and compels him to change his ways.

title: Gangster
desc: After moving to Seoul, Simran's life is thrown into turmoil when gangster Daya returns. Torn between her troubled past and her singer boyfriend Akash, she must choose her future.

title: Deewaanapan
desc: A passionate young man falls deeply in love, but his intense obsession and violent tendencies threaten to destroy the relationship, leading to a tragic and emotionally charged conflict.

title: Turtle

title: Yeh Vaada Raha
desc: Vikram's mother refuses his relationship with Sunita due to her background; the couple elopes, but a horrible accident tragically separates them.

title: Ladaai
desc: Wrongfully imprisoned for eighteen years, an exonerated man confronts the judge who convicted him, demanding she reopen the cold case, uncover the truth, and bring the real culprits to justice.
